sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: An evergreen woody climber native from Europe and the Mediterranean region to Iran. Young climbing stems attach by aerial roots and bear lobed leaves; adult flowering shoots have unlobed leaves.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: Small flowers grow in spherical umbels in autumn. The ripe berries reach about 9 mm across.

sections.title: Toxicity
sections.text: The leaves and berries can cause digestive upset; the plant can also irritate the skin of some people.
